### [2026-09-03 22:10:34 UTC] Live Screen Observation & Freeze Diagnosis
- **Visual Capture:** Chrome active on host desktop displaying `http://localhost:4002` (Marimo Three Coding Tests Studio).
- **Freeze Root Cause Identified:** Swap had ballooned to 11.75 GB with two duplicate background release instances of `lauburu_network_lens` (PID 12408 and 84981) spinning threads while `lens_host_ram_evacuation_daemon.py` was not running as a persistent daemon.
- **Freeze Healed:** Stale PIDs terminated; persistent background evacuation daemon (`lens_host_ram_evacuation_daemon.py --daemon`) launched to continuously enforce 9.6 GB host headroom.
- **Movesense APK Reverse Engineered:** Extracted split APKs from Pixel 10 Pro XL (`base.apk`, 22 MB); discovered `sample_ecg.mecg.zip` containing 512Hz ECG stream from Movesense MD sensor (`242230000604`).
